claims.content: To enable the customer to view and modify their account profile information, including user details, billing/shipping addresses, and shipping preferences.

goal.raw_text: To enable the customer to view and modify their account profile information, including user details, billing/shipping addresses, and shipping preferences.

claims.content: The customer must have a registered account with JTVauctions.com.
The customer must be logged into their account.
The customer navigates to the 'My Account' section from the global header.

trigger.raw_text: The customer navigates to the 'My Account' section from the global header.

claims.content: The customer navigates to the 'My Account' section from the global header.
The system displays the 'My Account' page, which includes sections for 'My Information', 'My Billing Address', and 'My Shipping Preferences'.
The customer clicks on the 'Edit' link next to the section they wish to modify (e.g., 'My Information').
The system displays the corresponding edit page (e.g., 'My Account Edit Page 1') with pre-populated fields containing the current account data.
The customer modifies the desired fields (e.g., changes email address, updates phone number).
The customer clicks the 'Save Changes' button.
The system validates the input data.
The system saves the updated information to the database.
The system displays a success message confirming the changes have been saved.
The system redirects the customer back to the 'My Account' page, reflecting the updated information.
